report:
The study reveals partial tear of anterior  and posterior cruciate ligaments, severe on PCL.  
 Horizontal tear at posterior horn of medial meniscus. 
  
 Normal medial and lateral collateral ligament is noted. 
 Normal anterior  posterior horn of   lateral meniscus is seen. 
 Normal articular surface is seen. 
 No bony destruction is noted. 
 JOInt effusion.  
 The localized bone edema in medial condule of distal femur. Partial tear of anterior  and posterior cruciate ligaments, severe on PCL.  
 Horizontal tear at posterior horn of medial meniscus.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática aguda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal del componente superficial y profundo del complejo nervio
medial en su aspecto proximal con pérdida parcial de la continuidad de sus fibras y edema las
partes blandas regionales. El resto de los componentes del complejo medial sin alteraciones.
Aumento de señal central periférico del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial
que no impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los cartílagos
femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total
de la rótula de distribución difusa.
Leve a moderado derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos de un esguince grado II del aspecto proximal del complejo ligamentario medial con edema
de las partes blandas regionales.
Condropatía superficial de platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía rotuliana con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de distribución difusa.
Leve a moderado derrame articular

> Mildly flat slope and laxity  of ACL and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear (grade 2-3 injury).

> Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia (major lateral tibial plateau) and distal femur( lateral femoral condyle and medial femoral condyle near MCL attachment), major at lateral side, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.

2. Grade 2-3 injury of ACL, in favor of ACL tear. 
3. Bone contusion of distal femoral condyle and proxiaml tibia.
4. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
5. R/O Ramp lesion of medial meniscus.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and physical examination

Fortgeschrittene, lateral betonte Pangonarthrose mit lateral flächig in der Belastungszone vollschichtiger Chondropathie beider Gelenkpartner und subkortikalen Ödemarealen. Außenmeniskus extrudiert mit mukoider Auffaserung der Pars intermedia sowie insbesondere des Vorderhorns. Die VH-Wurzel dabei nicht mehr nachvollziebar und aufgefasert im Gelenk liegend. Kein Ganglion bei gering flüssigkeitsgefülltem Recessus (6/27). Teils tiefergehende Chondropathie auch medial mit gering mukoidem Innenmeniskus ohne umschriebene Rissbildung. VKB gering mukoid und MCL mit geringem Reizzustand, ansonsten Bandapparat intakt. Dtl. Femoropatellararthrose, führend an der lateralen retropatellaren Facette sowie medialen Trochlea mit fokal tiefergehender Chondropathie und gering lateralisiert stehender Patella. Geringe Insertionstendinopathie der Patellarsehne am Unterpol. Mäßiger Erguss mit Reizsynovialitis. V.a. freien Gelenkkörper im lateralen Recessus suprapatellaris (9/18) sowie verkalkte Gelenkkörper am dorsomedialen Tibiaplateau (CC 13 mm, 6/10). Baker-Zyste mit CC 4,3 cm.

Menisküs hafif ekstrüde görünümdedir.Lateral reseste sıvı artışı izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Lateral kollateral çevresinde sıvı ve tendonda sinyal artışı mevcuttur. Popliteal  fossada 10x5 mm boyutlarında baker kisti izlendi. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz eklemi düzeyinde ve patellar bursada sıvı artışı izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan komşu yumuşak doku planlarında cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.İliotibial bant düzeyinde belirgin sıvı artışı, ödematöz görünüm ve tendonda sinyal artışı mevcuttur.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Assess for anterior cruciate ligament tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. Large radial tear posterior horn medial meniscus measuring at least 7 mm, with slight peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. Intrasubstance degeneration within the medial meniscal body without evidence of additional tear. The posterior root and anterior horn are intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament and biceps femoris tendon insertion are intact. Moderate popliteus tendinosis without tear. Iliotibial band is intact.

Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear. No patellofemoral subluxation. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Fissuring of articular cartilage central to medial femoral trochlea as well as overlying the medial patellar facet. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Baker's cyst, with cyst fluid tracking distally along the medial superficial fascia of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle consistent with cyst leakage. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Large radial tear posterior horn medial meniscus with medial meniscal extrusion.
2. Suspected prior tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament without patellofemoral subluxation.
3. Focal moderate chondrosis at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment.
4. Leaking Baker's cyst.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL and PCL mucoid degeneration. MCL normal. Medial meniscus tear. Lateral meniscus normal. OA of all three compartments. Baker's cyst. Mild effusion. Conclusion: Medial meniscus tear. ACL and PCL mucoid degeneration. OA of all three compartments. Baker's cyst. Mild effusion

MRI ΑΡ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς . ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Παρατηρήθηκαν τα εξής: 1. Μηνισκοθυλακική αποκόλληση αναγνωρίζεται στον έξω μηνίσκο με ρήξη της οπίσθιας άνω ιγνυο μηνισκικής δεσμίδας και του μηνισκομηριαίου συνδέσμου. 2. Ρήξη τύπου "λαβής κάδου" (bucket handle) παρατηρείται στον έσω μηνίσκο με μετατόπιση του μηνισκικού υλικού στην μεσοκονδύλια εντομή. 3. Ολική ρήξη πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου. 4. Ολική ρήξη οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου με παλαιό αποσπαστικό, πωρωθέν, κάταγμα στην κατάφυσή του, στην οπίσθια επιφάνεια της κνήμης. 5. Παρατηρείται οιδηματώδης απεικόνιση του πρόσθιου κνημιαίου μυός ως επί κάκωσησης του εν τω βάθει περονιαίου νεύρου. 6. Ο οστικός μώλωπας παρατηρείται σε φάση αποδρομής (συγκριτικά με την προηγούμενη εξέταση), κατά τον έσω μηριαίο και έσω κνημιαίο κόνδυλο. 7. Μικρά ξένα σώματα παρατηρούνται ενδοαρθρικά.  8. Λέπτυνση παρουσιάζει ο αρθρικός χόνδρος του έξω μηριαίου και έξω κνημιαίου κονδύλου από την προηγηθείσα κάκωση. 9. Οπισθίως του ραγέντος οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου, αναγνωρίζεται γαγγλιακή κύστη 22x18x9mm.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is no popliteal cysts.

There are moderate to severe degenerative changes. More specifically there are severe changes in the medial compartment with full-thickness cartilage loss of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is diffuse mild to moderate thinning of the cartilage in the lateral and patellofemoral compartments with no other regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is diffuse intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL with intraosseous ganglion cyst at the insertion on the tibia. The PCL is intact.

There is diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration, extrusion and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate to severe degenerative changes most pronounced medially.

2. Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration, extrusion and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus. Intrasubstance degeneration of the lateral meniscus without tear.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis without popliteal cyst.

Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kök yırtığının eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık izlendi. Medial menisküs ekstrüde görünümdedir.Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem izlendi ve ligamende sinyal artışı mevcuttur ( grade II sprain ).Arka çapraz bağ, ön çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdak medial faset düzeyinde yer yer kıkırdakta incelme ve subkondral milimetrik kist, ödem izlendi ( grade IV kondromalazi ). Suprapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde yaygın sıvı artışı  ve sinoviumda kalınlaşma  ( bursit  ve sinovit )  izlendi. Eklem kapsülü komşuluğunda yaygın ödematöz görünüm ve fokal kapsülde bütünlük kaybı, komşuluğunda büyüğü 12 mm çapta kistler izlendi.Femur interkondiler düzey anteriorlateralde  9x4 mm boyutlarında osteokondral defekt ve komşuluğunda kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitis sivrileşmeler , tibiofemoral eklem mesafesinde daralma , komşu kartilajlarda incelme ve subkondral ödem izlendi(dejeneratif artit bulguları). Tibia interkondiler tüberkül düzeyinde ve medial plato düzeyinde subkondral kistler ve kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.
